title: Checkout authorization request path
body: checkout-api requests a decision from fraud-service, then calls payment-api through its outbound payment-client connection pool. payment-api delegates external authorization to provider-adapter. Each checkout-api worker has its own pool. payment_client.pool.max_connections limits simultaneous outbound connections per worker; waiters share acquire_timeout_ms. Provider response timeout is a separate setting. Release configuration lives in the checkout-api repository.
